summary: Completed phases 22-26 of 26, the final leg of the core/theory_lib refactor. Phase 22 restored bimodal's missing iterate.py (git-restored, ported to the current generator convention, 7 new tests, closing the last theory-contract gap). Phase 23 flipped the conformance and layering tests fully green with a permanent zero-xfail guard. Phase 24 reconciled 16 documentation files with the enforced module contract. Phase 25 ran the full regression gate and wheel parity diff (zero unexplained deltas in either direction) and, discovering that exclusion/imposition failed a live scaffold-and-run check, fixed a scaffolded-project relative-import defect Phase 20 had deliberately deferred. Phase 26 recorded the refactor's durable decisions in specs/ROADMAP.md. Also fixed a genuine Phase-12 regression (stale utils.api.get_theory call site) surfaced by a broader test sweep. 25/26 phases are [COMPLETED]; Phase 2 remains [PARTIAL], unchanged, per its documented sandbox constraint.

blockers.description: Phase 2's full serial oracle suite run (550 tests) remains unattempted -- no pytest-xdist in this sandbox, resource contention on prior attempts. Collection count (550) and the 5 xfail(strict=True) line locations remain pinned and re-verified clean via verify-refactor.sh at this final checkpoint too. A future session with pytest-xdist or dedicated resources should re-attempt the full run and commit baselines/oracle-run.txt + junit-oracle.xml to fully close Phase 2. This does not block any other phase's acceptance criteria -- all 25 other phases are fully COMPLETED and independently verified.

files_modified: six module test READMEs + four per-theory docs/ARCHITECTURE.md files
decisions_made: BimodalModelIterator's _create_difference_constraint/_create_non_isomorphic_constraint/_create_stronger_constraint are confirmed dead code in the active search path (the loop always uses the shared, theory-agnostic ConstraintGenerator) but kept for interface parity with the other three theories, with the broken semantics.W/T references fixed rather than left in place

Fixed exclusion/imposition's scaffolded-project 3-dot relative-import defect (mirroring bimodal's own Phase 20 fix) because Phase 25's own scaffold-and-run verification step made it an acceptance blocker, even though Phase 20 had deliberately deferred it

Fixed code/tests/integration/test_system_imports.py's stale utils.api.get_theory call site (a genuine Phase-12 regression, invisible to every prior phase's narrower theory_lib+layering+builder sweep) rather than leaving it, since it was discovered while doing this session's own verification work

Did not attempt three failures confirmed pre-existing via empty git diffs on the exercised source AND already tracked in specs/ROADMAP.md's existing 28-failures follow-up item before this session began (Mock.assert_and_track misuse, timeout/resource-contention tests, the malformed 'A[]' formula literal)
dead_ends: Do not assume a theory-specific iterate.py override's difference-constraint methods drive search-time model exclusion -- iterate/iterator.py's active loop always calls a fresh, theory-agnostic ConstraintGenerator instead, so these methods are presentation/parity-only across all four theories, not dead-code-worth-deleting but also not worth defending as load-bearing
